usedFor: An Airtable row becomes a message in a Balsio thread at a set date and time.

bestTemplate.name: “Record Created Or Updated” in Airtable, then “Create Scheduled Message” in Balsio
bestTemplate.why: Its idempotency key guards against duplicate runs from repeated edits.

watchOut: “Create Scheduled Message” needs a thread ID, so store it on the Airtable record.
